acme_bob: hey team — after the model update yesterday our chatbot responses suddenly feel more clipped. not a hard bug but customers notice fewer clarifying steps. here are two quick examples (same prompt):

acme_bob: PROMPT: 'How do I reset my API key?'
BEFORE (v8.2): 'Go to Settings > API keys, click rotate, confirm. You will receive an email. Steps: 1) open settings 2) rotate 3) confirm. Let me know if you want the exact menu path.'
AFTER (v9.1): 'Rotate your API key in Settings.'

acme_bob: we didn't change prompts. small but impact on user success. any idea what changed?

eli_support: thanks for the report and examples — really helpful. can you confirm the exact model id and the request payload you used (including temperature/top_p) so we can repro? also which workspace/org id?

acme_bob: model header our side shows: `redwood-llm@v9.1` and we call the hosted text endpoint. payload is basically default: `{"model":"redwood-llm@v9.1","input":"How do I reset my API key?","temperature":0.0}`. org id is ACME-42. latency and tokens look normal.

eli_support: copying in @anita_research and @samir_prod. we'll try to reproduce. in the meantime, did you observe any difference with system messages or tool-calling behavior? any hits to function-calling that might shorten outputs?

anita_research: quick hypothesis: we rolled an internal decoding tweak plus a minor system-prompt condensation for v9.1 to reduce token cost. that can compress assistant verbosity in low-temp calls. can you paste a longer real-world conversation example (2-3 turns) so we can check prefix caching and context windows? :thinking:

acme_bob: sure, attaching a short convo: `User: I get 403 when calling /v1/keys; Bot: check headers, missing auth, show snippet?` before it would list exact header names + sample curl, now it just says 'check auth headers'. i'll paste snippet in a sec.

acme_bob: snippet:
```
POST /v1/keys
Authorization: Bearer xxxxx
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "action": "rotate"
}
```

eli_support: got it. @anita_research can you try repro with temperature=0.0 and temperature=0.2? also try pinning `redwood-llm@v8.2` for the customer to confirm behavior delta. we can offer a temporary pin if needed.

anita_research: ran local repro against the hosted sandbox. with v9.1 and temp=0.0 we see condensed answers similar to your 'after' example. v8.2 returns stepwise instructions. temp=0.2 on v9.1 increases elaboration slightly but not fully. looks like the change is in generation defaults + a mild system prompt trimming.

samir_prod: ops note: v9.1 release included a cost-optimization patch (shorter default assistant persona). rollback is possible for your org while we investigate, or we can enable a per-org prompt override that restores prior verbosity. which would you prefer @acme_bob?

acme_bob: temporary pin to v8.2 would be perfect while you debug. customers are confused by missing steps. thanks.

eli_support: request logged, initiating pin for ACME-42 to `redwood-llm@v8.2` for 72 hours. i'll follow up with the research team about a config knob to control verbosity. cc @ops-bot to track the rollout ID. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Deployment action: pin applied for org ACME-42 -> model redwood-llm@v8.2 (action_id: deploy-99214). timestamp: 2741256825

anita_research: next steps for us: 1) diff system prompts between v8.2 and v9.1, 2) run prompt-sensitivity evals on typical support prompts, 3) propose a response-length-safe flag. will update in #eng-ml after initial findings.

acme_bob: appreciate the quick turnaround. please keep us posted.

eli_support: will do — leaving this open until research confirms root cause and live config options. feel free to DM if anything else pops up.
